# Imagine source

Production source from `mecattaf/dotfiles` commit
`435e61f084fce5f4892dad608703eb10a5ad8d49`, directory
`pkgs/client-desktop/imagine`. MIT notices remain in LICENSE and
`src/imagine/LICENSE`. Tests, historical evidence, personal configuration,
fonts and credentials were excluded. Paired Domicile source and engine are
pinned by the root flake; source identity alone is not physical acceptance.

Tarek-specific onboarding additions, when present, live under `src/mac17`
and are separate from the inherited Imagine behavior.
